food.excerpt: Kufri Jamunia, promoted by the Centre and developed by ICAR-CPRI, carries 3.22 mg of iron and 2.28 mg of zinc per 100 grams — several times a common potato — in a country where 57% of women and 67.1% of young children are anaemic.
food.nri_angle: For diaspora readers following India's nutrition challenge, a biofortified staple shows how agricultural research is tackling anaemia through everyday food rather than supplements alone.

food.nri_angle: Meghalayan cuisine is almost impossible to find in diaspora restaurant hubs abroad, making this state-backed tour a rare showcase of Khasi, Garo and Jaintia food culture for NRIs visiting India.

travel.title: Air India and IndiGo Cut Europe Flights as Winter Capacity Falls 6.5% — and Foreign Carriers Take the Passengers
travel.excerpt: Air India ends Delhi-Vienna and its Birmingham services and IndiGo has suspended Manchester and will pause Heathrow, as India-Europe winter seats fall to 5.63 million; longer routings around closed airspace and high fuel costs are driving the cuts.
travel.image_caption: An Air India aircraft in flight. Air India and IndiGo are cutting Europe capacity this winter as foreign carriers take a larger share of passengers.
travel.nri_angle: Fewer nonstops mean diaspora travellers between India and Europe face more one-stop itineraries via Gulf and European hubs this winter — book early for Diwali and Christmas peaks.
